M docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile
---
diff --git a/docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile b/docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile
index c299e12..a496cba 100644
--- a/docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile
+++ b/docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile
@@ -48,8 +48,14 @@ RUN apk update && apk add \
     g++ \
     make
 
+# Back up the base image libapk before overwriting (node image ships an older
+# libapk with the same SONAME, which would break the apk binary)
+RUN cp /usr/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0 /usr/local/etc/libapk.so.3.0.0.base
+
 # Copy files from node image
 COPY --from=node /usr/lib /usr/lib
+# Restore the base image libapk so apk keeps working
+RUN cp /usr/local/etc/libapk.so.3.0.0.base /usr/lib/libapk.so.3.0.0
 COPY --from=node /usr/local/share /usr/local/share
 COPY --from=node /usr/local/lib /usr/local/lib
 COPY --from=node /usr/local/include /usr/local/include

observation.command: cd /workspace && git status --short 2>&1 | head -10; echo "---"; git --no-pager diff docker/tooling/tooling.Dockerfile 2>&1 | head -40
